claim: Uses latent imagined trajectories to train actor and critic behavior rather than only searching action sequences online.
claim_zh: 在潜在世界模型生成的想象轨迹上训练actor和critic，而非仅靠在线搜索动作序列。
innovation_detail: Uses latent imagined trajectories to train actor and critic behavior rather than only searching action sequences online.
innovation_detail_zh: 在潜在世界模型生成的想象轨迹上训练actor和critic，而非仅靠在线搜索动作序列。
bottleneck: Online planning alone can be computationally expensive for long-horizon behavior optimization.
bottleneck_zh: 单纯依靠在线规划的长时域行为优化可能计算开销较大。
tradeoff: Policy quality can degrade when imagined latent dynamics are inaccurate; clinical transfer remains speculative.
